$comment: Authored contract for the com.deepseek.harness client extension namespace (Agent Plugins §8.1). Documentation-grade: the runtime applies the strategy-chain rules in src/catalog, not this file. The extension namespace is client-defined by specification; this schema records what this manager reads.
title: com.deepseek.harness namespace extension data

schemaVersion.description: Namespace contract version the suite was written against. Only 1.0.0 is implemented; any other value skips both namespace seats and keeps the portable core.

mcpServers.description: Per-server client policy keyed by the server's own name in the suite's portable mcp.json. Names without a matching server are reported and ignored.

auth.description: OAuth 2.1 authorization for Streamable HTTP / SSE servers that answer 401 with a challenge; the flow activates on the server's first 401.

enabled.description: Enable the OAuth flow (default true; false opts out explicitly).

scope.description: Space-separated scope string requested during authorization.

enabledTools.description: Allow-list of model-facing tool names; absent means all tools.

disabledTools.description: Deny-list of model-facing tool names applied after the allow-list.

startupTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds allowed between spawn and a completed MCP handshake before the mount fails.

toolCallTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds allowed for one tool call before it is cancelled.
